description: Performance ads. Mints a test click (click_id, tclk_...) and a draft_key, to prove the integration before an order. Give destination_template (your https landing URL with {click_id}) for a new ad, or ad_id to test an existing one. Then send one signed test event for the click (send_sandbox_event), and order with the draft_key in product_options.draft_key. A verified test event counts for one ad.

ad_id.description: The id of an ad of this account.

api_key.description: The API key of the account (can_live_...). Optional when this MCP connection sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.

destination_template.description: The https landing URL of the ad, with {click_id} where the click id goes.

draft_key.description: Only to add another test click to a draft_key you already hold.

name: create_sandbox_click
title: Create a sandbox test click
